steps.what: Locate current student organisation policies and the actual organisation's request
Discuss student plans, support student choices and give actual organisation advice
Write and check assigned advisory follow-up notes and retain the internal record

tasks.design: Configure current student-policy links in {DOCS} so the adviser can locate sources for an actual request. Keep student discussion, judgement and assigned written follow-up fully human; the ordinary internal note save carries no self-gate or saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Policy versions can require repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native current-version links remove some navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Students need advice fitted to their organisation and circumstances.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher supports student agency while identifying unsafe or exclusionary plans.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less policy navigation; advisory responsibility stays unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: current policy links can reduce navigation while student advice and actual follow-up require human attention.

assumptions: Provisional boundary includes teacher-owned internal advisory notes only where actually required; remove that branch and reweight if students own all notes. No transcript or student decision is invented. Three of15 source points are repeated navigation; actual policy reading remains.

Policy owners supply document id, version, scope and effective status; students supply their actual request. Missing versions require manual owner lookup. Advice is delivered in s2; internal notes in s3 are not a second send.
unknowns: Which notes does the adviser actually own?
research_questions: Can current links avoid obsolete student-event policies?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes3 locating points minus0.3 upkeep=2.7. Low: a novel organisation request needs manual policy interpretation and source finding, leaving only1 known-policy navigation point removed, minus0.3=0.7. Advice and written follow-up keep all their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write proposals for external agricultural research funding.

steps.what: Choose agricultural research question, methods, justified budget and actual project commitments
inputs: actual research evidence and cost basis
outputs: chosen research project, budget and commitments

steps.what: Assemble funder sections, organisation fields, budget tables and verified references
inputs: chosen research project, budget and commitments
actual funding call and organisation fields

steps.what: Write proposal narrative from the chosen research plan and actual evidence
inputs: chosen research project, budget and commitments

loop.purpose: Draft selected project narrative without creating research claims
loop.input: chosen methods, verified evidence, actual budget and funder sections
loop.check: Teacher checks meaning, novelty claims, methods, feasibility, unsupported promises and omitted limitations against sources
loop.stop: Missing source or two failed revisions returns affected section to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native fields and tables serve s2; varied research explanations require semantic drafting and checking

steps.what: Finish and check final proposal, budget, commitments and exact funding destination
inputs: actual research evidence and cost basis
outputs: checked saved final proposal package and destination

steps.what: Review final proposal and authorise the institution's actual funding submission
inputs: checked saved final proposal package and destination
outputs: independently authorised final proposal version and destination

steps.what: Submit authorised final research proposal to the named external funder
inputs: independently authorised final proposal version and destination

tasks.design: Configure funder sections and verified table reuse in {DOCS}/{GOV_PORTAL}, then draft variable narrative only from the teacher's chosen project. Keep full final checks, ordinary internal saving, the actual institutional signatory review and explicit external submission.
tasks.previous_blocker: Funder structure and first-draft prose are repeatedly prepared around scientific decisions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native section reuse and constrained drafting reduce assembly and typing.
tasks.still_hard: Research merit, field feasibility and institutional promises need accountable researchers.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher rejects an attractive proposed outcome unsupported by the field design.
tasks.altitude: Less proposal preparation; project and funding authority stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native funder sections and source-constrained drafting can assist research proposals without deciding research merit.

assumptions: Provisional route with an existing independent research signatory5, excluded from focal baseline95. No new approval ceremony. Six assembly points and6.25 prose-typing points are removed after retained review; existing automation earns zero credit.

Teacher supplies actual project aims/methods and verified references; finance supplies dated cost rates, currency and cost categories; institutional owners supply organisation fields. Missing evidence or cost justification is obtained manually. Final version, budget and exact funder destination exist before signatory review; changes invalidate it.
unknowns: What drafting and disclosure rules does the actual call set?
Which submission route does the teacher own?
research_questions: Can each promise, reference and budget line be traced to actual project evidence?

incremental.description: Maintain funder sections and source-linked narrative checks.

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact saved final proposal, budget, commitments and named funder destination reviewed in s5; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes6 assembly plus6.25 prose points:12.25/95*100 minus1.3=11.594. Low: a new experimental field design needs fresh scientific narrative, leaving4 reusable table/structure points and2 descriptive typing points, giving6/95*100 minus1.3=5.016. Research design, complete checks, signatory review and actual send remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Serve on academic and administrative committees.

steps.what: Locate current committee agenda, institutional policy versions and prior decisions
inputs: current institutional papers and prior decisions

steps.what: Study issues and deliberate on actual institutional, departmental and academic matters
Write and check the teacher's assigned committee comments and action notes
outputs: checked saved assigned committee comments and actions

tasks.design: Configure a versioned committee packet index in {DOCS}. Reduce repeat navigation while retaining substantive reading, deliberation and assigned written comments/actions in the shared {DOCS}/{PROJECT} workspace.
tasks.previous_blocker: Agenda papers can point to scattered policy versions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native metadata links can expose the actual current packet.
tasks.still_hard: Institutional priorities and conflicting academic interests require deliberation.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher recognises how a policy proposal affects practical teaching work.
tasks.altitude: Less packet navigation; committee authority stays unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native document indexes can reduce committee-paper navigation without replacing deliberation.

assumptions: Provisional shares: three of20 source points are repeated navigation; actual reading remains. Teacher-owned comments/actions are separated from conversation and fully retained, including ordinary save. Committee secretary's minutes and policy publication are outside focal labour and not fabricated here.

Committee secretary/policy owners supply actual agenda id, paper version, decision date and current status; missing or conflicting sources require manual confirmation. No meeting outcome is inferred from an agenda. Add an actual separate send only if this teacher owns one; no saving is assumed for it.
unknowns: Does the committee already publish a current linked packet?
research_questions: Can packet links preserve the distinction between proposals and adopted policy?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes3 repeated navigation points minus0.3 upkeep=2.7. Low: an exceptional policy proposal introduces new papers, leaving only0.5 prior-decision locating points removed, minus0.3=0.2. Reading, deliberation and written comments retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Participate in campus and community events.

steps.what: Read actual campus or community event details and prepare the teacher's contribution
outputs: understood event arrangements and prepared contribution

steps.what: Participate in actual campus and community events and interact with attendees
inputs: understood event arrangements and prepared contribution

steps.what: Enter and check any actually required participation or follow-up record
outputs: checked saved actual participation record when required

tasks.design: Keep event preparation, attendance and interaction human. Inspect any actual record in {DOCS} separately: it needs the teacher's fresh observations, so its writing and ordinary internal save also stay unchanged.
tasks.previous_blocker: The task's value is real presence and interaction.
tasks.enabler_now: No specified change removes this work.
tasks.still_hard: Useful participation requires attention to actual people and events.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher builds trust and responds to unplanned questions.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: attending community events and recording fresh personal observations cannot be replaced by pre-existing event schedules.

assumptions: Provisional boundary separates an actual participation record only where assigned; it is not assumed universal. If no record exists, drop s3 and reweight unchanged participation/preparation. No invented event report, transcript, broadcast or extra send is added to create savings.

Organiser supplies actual time, location and requested contribution; the teacher supplies actual observations only after participation. A calendar entry proves neither attendance nor interactions. Existing calendar conveniences earn no new saving; no implementation means zero incremental upkeep.
unknowns: Is any participation record actually required of this teacher?
research_questions: Does actual event work include any second-system entry beyond these retained observations?

incremental.description: No new system or process is introduced.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Preparation, participation and the separately inspected actual record all retain100%; no send or second-system transfer is identified and no new upkeep is introduced. Both a simple campus gathering and a community event needing fresh follow-up observations therefore yield zero specified saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce selected grant preparation and source navigation while retaining teaching-community responsibilities.
role.ambitious_version: More reliable preparation around unchanged academic and community judgement.
